profile_text.body:
Adobe is a public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA. It reported revenue of $23,769,000,000 for the fiscal year ending November 28, 2025, and trades on public markets under the ticker ADBE. The company's Express product page describes Adobe Express as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool intended to make content creation easy, with capabilities spanning social content, videos, and logos, and an AI Assistant that the site says allows users to prompt, create, and edit anything while preserving chosen elements of a design.

Adobe tracks several AI products across design, video, and audio categories. Adobe Firefly is the company's image generation model, which Adobe describes as trained on commercially safe data. Adobe Express AI is a lightweight design tool that integrates Firefly for quick content creation and carries the same commercial-safe characterization. Premiere Pro AI applies generative features, including generative extend and color match, to professional video editing, and Adobe Podcast AI offers speech enhancement and microphone check tools for audio, also described by Adobe as commercially safe in its training. The company holds a CIK of 0000796343 with the SEC, and no litigation or MCP server entries are recorded in the held facts for this profile.
